Source code analysis confirms SearchParams are passed through directly as []*commonpb.KeyValuePair without any range validation. HNSW index ef (exploration factor) parameter has objective mathematical constraint ef ≥ 1 for meaningful search behavior. This violates physical constraints (Step 3.5 source grounding: no validation in handler.go line 357-375, wrap_request.go line 383-397). Contract (structured_contract.json) has no ef constraint, but source code reveals validation absence. Matches developer blindspot pattern 'rest-v2-data-type-handling' (26 historical issues). Reproducible on clean Milvus 2.6.10 with both ef=0 and ef=-5 returning HTTP 200.
